title.note: Game title kept in English per glossary (keep); players search the English title.
title.blind_remark: not translated: left in English, in Latin script

hud.cast.note: Infinitive on buttons (guide); 'закинути вудку' is the fishing verb. 8/8.

hud.reel.note: 'Pull (the fish) out', perfective infinitive like Закинути; same verb as the pass name Автовитягування. 'Тягнути' (7) also fits if the action is a long hold.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form avoids the plural forms (1 наживка / 2 наживки / 5 наживок).

catch.success.note: 'Rare catch: Golden Carp!'. Rarity tiers are masculine (Рідкісний, Міфічний) and agree with 'улов', never with the fish name, so any fish gender works; 'You caught' is folded into 'улов', which also avoids gendered past 'зловив/зловила'.

catch.escaped.note: 'The fish slipped off the hook', the usual angler's phrase; generic 'риба' since any species can escape. Single ellipsis character per guide.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; Ukrainian writes '12,4' (decimal comma), so format it per locale in code.

fish.golden_carp.note: 'короп' is the Ukrainian word for carp; 'карп' is the Russian form.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Invented name built on the Ukrainian fish-name pattern 'риба-ліхтар', 'риба-меч'; keeps the lantern idea. Masculine nominative, so it fits catch.success. Literal 'Ліхтарний вугор' (15) reads like 'lamppost eel'.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine tier form like Легендарний / Рідкісний; agrees with 'улов' in catch.success. Reads as the tier above Легендарний, as in other games.

shop.equip.note: 'Take (this rod)'; 'Екіпірувати' (11) is over budget and stiff for kids. 'Обрати' / 'Обрано' is the alternative pair if a reviewer prefers a select wording.
shop.equip.blind_remark: "Взяти" literally means "take"; on a shop card it could read as taking or getting the rod rather than equipping it

shop.equipped.note: 'In hand' = in use: a state, not an action, and it needs no gender agreement with the rod.

shop.free.note: 9/8 est.: the shortest natural price word ('Безкоштовно' is 11). 'Даром' (5) fits but sounds like market slang; widen the label by one character if it clips.

shop.buy_robux.blind_remark: the word "Robux" is left in Latin script

pass.auto_reel.note: 15/14 est.: built like 'автозбереження' from the same verb as Витягти (hud.reel). Shorter options lose the shared verb ('Автоулов', 8, = auto catch). Match the pass name in Creator Hub.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Наживка удачі подвоює шанс зловити рідкісну рибу!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name built like the guide's 'Зілля удачі'; 'your' dropped (guide).

sell.done.note: Two label forms with colons avoid plural agreement for count and coins (1 риба / 2 риби / 5 риб).

sell.prompt.note: Latin E; 'Тисни' as in the guide's prompt example, since 'Натисни E, щоб продати' is 22/21. For the developer: phone and console players have no E key; ProximityPrompt ActionText 'Продати' would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: Prestige: the gaming word Ukrainian players know for this mechanic. Avoids religious 'Вознесіння' and climbing 'Піднятися'; kept distinct from rebirth 'Переродження'.

ascend.confirm.text: Отримати престиж зараз? Ти почнеш усе спочатку, але ловитимеш рідкісну рибу на {bonus}% частіше.
ascend.confirm.note: Same term Престиж as the button. Future tense 'почнеш', 'ловитимеш' is gender-neutral; 'усе' after a consonant per euphony rule.

weather.storm.note: 'клює' is the fishing sense of 'biting'. 'буря' rather than 'шторм' (a sea storm), since the game is on a lake.

quest.catch_n.note: Count after a colon avoids plural forms for n = 1. Moonlit Bay = 'Місячна затока', generic word lowercase as in 'Чорне море'; locative case here.

friends.boost.text: Риболовля з друзями дає +{percent}% до удачі
friends.boost.note: '+10% до удачі' is the usual game phrasing for a stat bonus.

trade.sent.note: Impersonal 'надіслано' and the fixed noun 'гравцю' keep it gender-neutral; Latin names do not decline. 32/33.

trade.accept.note: Fixed masculine noun head 'Гравець' carries the past-tense agreement, the guide's pattern for any-gender names.

codes.redeemed.note: 'Enjoy your reward' becomes 'The reward is yours!', the friendly Ukrainian equivalent; 'Насолоджуйся нагородою' reads translated. 'активувати' for redeem (guide).

afk.kicked.text: Ти надто довго нічого не робиш, тому риболовлю зупинено.
afk.kicked.note: Present 'не робиш' (have been doing nothing) avoids gendered past 'був/була неактивний'; no mention of leaving the server, as in the source.

event.ends.note: Label form ('Until the end: ...'); 'До кінця події' (16) is over budget. For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; Ukrainian needs '2 дн. 4 год', so format it per locale in code.

daily.streak.text: {day}-й день поспіль! Повертайся завтра по нові нагороди!
daily.streak.note: '{day}-й день' is correct for every number because 'день' is masculine; 'поспіль' (in a row) is how Ukrainian says the streak in a sentence (terms.json keeps 'серія' for labels). 'for more' = more rewards; 'по + accusative' as in the guide.

tip.night.text: Порада: деякі риби клюють лише вночі.

group.join.text: Вступи до групи й отримай 50 наживок безплатно!
group.join.note: Fixed number 50 takes the genitive plural 'наживок'; 'й' between vowels (guide).
group.join.review_reason: shop.free says "Безплатно" (chosen to fit its tight price label), so the banner uses the same word for free instead of "безкоштовно"; both are standard, but one game should use one.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest fish': 'Найбільший улов' would read as the biggest total haul, and the board ranks one fish by weight.
